Efficient Vision-Language Pretraining for Document Understanding

Abstract

We present an efficient pretraining method for vision-language models applied to document understanding tasks. Our approach halves compute while matching accuracy.

1 Introduction

Document understanding requires jointly modeling layout and text. Prior systems are compute hungry.

1.1 Motivation

Practitioners need affordable pretraining recipes.

2 Method

Our objective combines masked layout modeling with contrastive alignment where the loss is L over patches.

DISPLAY_EQUATION_GIBBERISH

We train with a two-stage curriculum.

3 Experimental Setup

We evaluate on three document benchmarks with frozen backbones.

4 Results and Discussion

Our method matches the state of the art at half the compute budget.

5 Conclusion

Efficient pretraining is practical for document AI.

A Additional Proofs

We include the full derivation of the objective.
